channel.title: U.S. District Court, District of Maine — Opinions
channel.description: Full-text D. Maine opinions via CourtListener (Free Law Project), a free Atom feed of the court's published opinions with citation metadata. Replaces the former page_monitor gateway to med.uscourts.gov/district-court-opinions, which was a static "find opinions on govinfo.gov" page that listed no opinions of its own.
